mentions.name: Aurora Glass
mentions.description: A free Mac menu bar app that displays a living, animated aurora across the menu bar, which also doubles as a status light for coding agents. Requires no account and no permissions.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Aurora Glass, a living aurora animated across your Mac's menu bar.

It doubles as a status light for coding agents. But mostly I just like looking at it.

Free, no account, no permissions: https://aurora.radiantmachines.com
